digest.component_or_area: Configuration and credential access control (RP-04 composition seam enforcement)
propositions: The codebase allows direct or aliased ambient configuration and credential reads below approved composition seams, bypassing centralized ownership control.

An AST-based deterministic gate must enforce that every environment access, credential read, and configurable adapter default has exactly one approved owner entry in an authoritative registry, rejecting unowned new declarations.

Legacy ambient facades, per-job SSM paths, migration exceptions, and backend property reloads must be removed only after all structural gates, behavioral suites, and bounded live canaries (provider, AWS review-bot, reconciler) pass with redacted evidence.

Generated operator documentation (config.md, security.md) must be kept byte-current with the authoritative schema and ownership registries and cover lifecycle, precedence, restart, observability, subprocess, and behavior-delta topics.
